findings.concern: A matrix could turn producer availability into an implicit soundness promise.
findings.resolution: Each row states its input/contract boundary; the page distinguishes LSP discovery, CMT TOP-marking, native producers and custom NDJSON.

findings.concern: Coverage metadata could be represented as universal run provenance.
findings.resolution: The page now says coverage records apply when the coverage-matrix pass has run and that their absence proves neither outcome.

findings.concern: OCaml details might again shape the entry path.
findings.resolution: OCaml has one dedicated row/section linking advanced docs; the page begins with producer-neutral selection.
